title: Causally prior broad-dollar whole-portfolio state

research_height.transfer_path: official prior-week broad-dollar appreciation -> paired-anchor birth-state value and stop quality -> at most one whole-portfolio suppression information seed

central_question: Does a causally available prior weekly strengthening of the Federal Reserve nominal broad dollar index make the entire qualified paired-month anchor birth cohort economically loss-making and materially worse than nonstrengthening weeks, broadly enough to retain exactly one whole-portfolio birth-suppression information seed?

why_now.optimization_bottleneck: The paired-month anchor is strongly profitable but its native equity drawdown is 20.256887565 percent and its independent forward is only modestly positive. The canonical Live-Dev snapshot remains unchanged at three complete lifecycles, so those rows cannot support a new tuned rule.
why_now.new_data_role: The official daily broad dollar index supplies a complete threshold-free, causally lagged portfolio-wide liquidity/risk state not previously applied to the paired-month anchor.
why_now.decision_if_true: Retain one fixed whole-portfolio suppression information seed for a later, separately declared Optimization fixed-path comparison after a new full-map comparison.
why_now.decision_if_false: Preserve every paired-anchor birth and close the complete broad-dollar state bundle without level, magnitude, subindex, lag, window, book, component or sizing rescue.

whole_map_recomparison.program_1: Unit 102 body engulfing and Unit 103 ordered lead-lag both closed with complete P1 economic nonconfirmation. No adjacent threshold, magnitude, symbol or hold successor is opened.
whole_map_recomparison.program_2: Selected because this is a new official external field with a whole-portfolio suppression role. It is not a US30-versus-US100 rotation, not a prior price proxy and not a reuse of prior VIX, rates, breadth, CFTC, SLOOS, H.4.1, gold/yen or scheduled-event roles.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: No new placement-time quote, fill, rejection, latency, handoff, queue or occupancy field exists; execution remains closed.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: No causally previsible held-position checkpoint or exit state exists; exits remain unchanged.
whole_map_recomparison.program_5: Weights, portfolio reconstruction, component state, risk caps, account drawdown, slots, capital ladders and ownership axes are already closed; this unit changes no size or capacity rule.
whole_map_recomparison.program_7: No diagnostic-only field can add economic value or starts. Official vintage alignment is integrity evidence inside Program 2, not a separate Program 7 unit.
whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 plus all heights. Do not automatically open another broad-dollar threshold, lag, window, subindex, book, component, direction, event, exit, sizing or retained-seed successor.

distinction_from_closed_work.prior_vix: Prior VIX studied an equity-volatility relative regime. This unit uses an official trade-weighted dollar level change and asks only whether to suppress the entire paired portfolio.
distinction_from_closed_work.treasury_curve: Prior Treasury work used interest-rate curve movement. This unit has no yield, spread, duration or rate direction.
distinction_from_closed_work.cash_breadth_and_three_index_dispersion: Those units used equity price participation or cross-index dispersion. This state comes from an external official currency index and has no intraday peer-price input.
distinction_from_closed_work.cftc_and_sloos: Those units used positioning or quarterly bank credit supply and studied relative book roles. This weekly field makes no relative US30/US100 selection.
distinction_from_closed_work.h41_reserves: H.4.1 used central-bank reserve balances and a US100-relative book question. This unit uses the nominal broad dollar and only a global suppression decision.
distinction_from_closed_work.gold_yen: Gold/yen was a two-market risk state. This unit has one threshold-free official broad-dollar sign.
distinction_from_closed_work.live_dev: Live-Dev supplies the exact qualified anchor behavior and current unchanged observation boundary, but no Live source, runtime, log, state or broker surface is read or changed.

immutable_inputs.manifest_rule: Sort name|bytes|uppercase SHA-256 by name, join with LF and SHA-256 UTF-8 without a trailing LF.

implementation.role: One frozen source-free research aggregation; not a validator, parity checker, test harness, reusable CLI product or trading executable.

official_source_contract.field: Nominal Broad Dollar Index - Daily Index
official_source_contract.interpretation: Higher index values represent U.S. dollar appreciation against the broad trading-partner currency basket.
official_source_contract.publication: Previous business week released Monday at 4:15 p.m.; a Monday federal holiday shifts release to the following business day.
official_source_contract.revision_boundary: This unit pins the official Board table as retrieved on 2026-08-29 and makes no real-time-vintage reconstruction claim beyond the conservative seven-calendar-day exclusion.

period_roles.P1: Discovery only, with 2022H2 and 2023 reported separately. P1 alone may open later economics.
period_roles.P5: Independent forward latest two completed months; veto only, never threshold or state selection.

fixed_state_and_mapping.daily_normalization: Retain every finite official date/index observation from 2022-06-01 through 2026-08-21 in ascending order.
fixed_state_and_mapping.weekly_observation: Group by ISO week and take its last finite daily observation.
fixed_state_and_mapping.STRENGTHENING: Current weekly last minus prior weekly last is strictly positive.
fixed_state_and_mapping.NONSTRENGTHENING: Current weekly last minus prior weekly last is strictly negative.
fixed_state_and_mapping.flat: An exact zero violates the frozen 220-state structural anchor; no third state or imputation is allowed.
fixed_state_and_mapping.causal_lookup: For birth server date D, select the latest weekly state reference date no later than D minus seven calendar days.
fixed_state_and_mapping.state_ownership: Assign state at BIRTH and retain it through the unique matching CLOSE.
fixed_state_and_mapping.no_transform: No level, magnitude, percentile, z-score, moving average, alternate weekly endpoint, AFE/EME subindex, contemporaneous value, interaction, direction choice or threshold.

anchor_lifecycle_contract.selection_source: Exact 1,428-lifecycle qualified paired-month MT5 selection observation.
anchor_lifecycle_contract.forward_source: Exact 54-lifecycle independent paired-month MT5 forward observation.
anchor_lifecycle_contract.pairing: Within each source, require exactly one BIRTH and one CLOSE per position identifier; peer-natural-exit rows are descriptive and excluded from economics.
anchor_lifecycle_contract.planned_risk: Positive BIRTH planned_risk_usd must equal matching CLOSE planned_risk_usd.
anchor_lifecycle_contract.stressed_net: Matching CLOSE stressed_net_usd from the qualified doubled-cost observation.
anchor_lifecycle_contract.stressed_r: CLOSE stressed_net_usd divided by positive planned risk at birth.
anchor_lifecycle_contract.stop: One only for DEAL_REASON_SL/STOP; zero only for DEAL_REASON_EXPERT/NATIVE.
anchor_lifecycle_contract.fixed_path_only: Suppression value is descriptive subtraction of strengthening-state closes. No admission replacement, freed capacity, capital reuse, compounding reconstruction, native fill or native drawdown is claimed.

premetric_structural_feasibility.scope: Only official index date/value, event/server date, component, symbol and position identity were consumed. No lifecycle actual/stressed outcome, planned risk, stop, conditional R, gate or verdict was read or calculated.

requirements: All six filenames, byte lengths, SHA-256 hashes and the canonical manifest match this declaration.
The frozen script byte length and SHA-256 match this declaration.
Official HTML contains the exact August 24, 2026 release date, daily-table title, Monday 4:15 p.m. previous-business-week schedule and holiday shift text.
The normalized index has exactly 1,057 unique increasing positive finite rows with exact first and last anchors.
Weekly reconstruction has exactly 221 records and 220 nonflat states: 111 strengthening and 109 nonstrengthening.
Lifecycle CSV headers and event counts match exactly; each BIRTH pairs uniquely with one CLOSE and preserves component, symbol, entry time and planned risk.
Selection reproduces 1,428 closes, actual/stressed +5786.63/+5477.524 and 130 stops; forward reproduces 54 closes, +32.74/+30.626 and 17 stops.
Every birth maps to one state aged 7 through 14 days and every exact period, split, book and component count anchor reconstructs before economics.

fixed_metrics.state_cell: Count, planned risk, actual net, stressed net, mean and median stressed R, stop count and stop rate.
fixed_metrics.effect: STRENGTHENING minus NONSTRENGTHENING mean stressed R and stop rate.
fixed_metrics.P1_views: Pooled P1, 2022H2, 2023, US30, US100 and each of Cross, Return, Pressure, Range61 and Range64.
fixed_metrics.later_views: Only after every P1 gate passes: P2, P3, P4, P5, pooled P2-P4, full P1-P5, full books and full components.
fixed_metrics.avoided_loss_concentration: For each period or component, contribution is max(0, negative strengthening stressed net). Maximum contribution divided by total positive avoided loss; if total is zero the share is 1.0.

requirements: P1 strengthening actual net is strictly negative.
P1 strengthening stressed net is strictly negative.
P1 strengthening-minus-nonstrengthening mean stressed-R effect is at most -0.10R.
P1 strengthening-minus-nonstrengthening stop-rate effect is at least +0.05.
2022H2 strengthening stressed net is strictly negative.
2023 strengthening stressed net is strictly negative.
US30 strengthening stressed net is strictly negative.
US100 strengthening stressed net is strictly negative.
At least four of five components have strictly negative strengthening stressed net.
fixed_p1_discovery_gate.failure_action: If any P1 requirement fails, calculate and report no P2-P5 economic outcome and close with no seed.

requirements: P2, P3 and P4 strengthening actual and stressed nets are each strictly negative.
Pooled P2-P4 strengthening actual and stressed nets are strictly negative.
Pooled P2-P4 mean stressed-R effect is at most -0.05R and stop-rate effect is at least +0.025.
P5 strengthening actual and stressed nets are nonpositive, mean stressed-R effect is nonpositive and stop-rate effect is nonnegative.
Full P1-P5 strengthening actual and stressed nets are strictly negative.
Full US30 and US100 strengthening stressed nets are separately strictly negative.
At least four of five full components have strictly negative strengthening stressed net.
No period supplies more than 65 percent and no component more than 60 percent of positive avoided strengthening-state stressed loss.

fixed_verdict_rules.pass: PASS_PRIOR_BROAD_DOLLAR_RETAIN_ONE_PORTFOLIO_RISK_SUPPRESSION_INFORMATION_SEED only when integrity, every P1 gate and every later/latest/full gate pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.discovery_failure: FAIL_PRIOR_BROAD_DOLLAR_NO_P1_PORTFOLIO_RISK_STATE_NO_SEED when integrity passes but any P1 gate fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.later_failure: FAIL_PRIOR_BROAD_DOLLAR_CONFIRMATION_OR_LATEST_NO_SEED when every P1 gate passes but any later/latest/full gate fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.correction: Any source, environment, design, invocation, implementation, parser, serialization or packaging fault is a correction state without economic verdict and without an arbitrary retry cap while this frozen economic contract remains unchanged.

decision_translation.pass: Retain exactly one whole-portfolio suppression information seed. It may inform a later independently declared fixed-path Optimization proxy only after a complete map comparison; it has no native capacity, compounding, fill, drawdown, MQL, MT5, Lab engineering or Live authority.
decision_translation.failure: Preserve every current paired-anchor component, birth, risk, slot, capital, stop and exit rule and retain no broad-dollar seed.
decision_translation.correction: Correct engineering until one valid fixed process exists; never count correction as economic failure.
